note: Measured facts not written by backend/eval/export_facts.py (scan benchmarks). An entry with the same id as an exported fact replaces it.

facts.label: Scans: room areas within 5 % of the CAD original, from the image alone
facts.scope: 909 rooms on 32 held-back Swiss Dwellings floor plans, read as PNG images without their CAD file; plans that state their scale
facts.method: A vision model outlines each labelled room on the image, the outline is snapped to the drawn lines, and its area is compared with the CAD original of the same floor
facts.caveat: Scans only, no CAD or BIM file. Plans without a stated scale are not included: there the scale is estimated and areas are shown as estimates.
